title: Canonical normalized field-tower purity transpose arrows
statement: Fix the finite field and prime datum P of [def-pur-conventions] and the finite coefficient extensions E in its fixed Q_ell closure [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For schemes X,Y and f:X→Y fix a compactification c, the ordinary system coefficient models and proper/open scalar comparison b of [lem-sp-field-shriek-system-comparison], and their normalized constructible domains N, specified adjoints and exceptional counit comparison of [lem-sp-field-exceptional-system-comparison]. Normalized means [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and whole-system scalar tensor means [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use the canonical projection tensor coordinates of [lem-sp-field-projection-system-square] and projection maps of [def-exchange-projection]. Define ScalarUnit by the ordinary section-normalized coefficient multiplication isomorphism and its derived localization through the specified resolving counit. Define Coordinates as the canonical tensor/unit/pullback data together with membership of the coefficient unit and pullback/tensor sources in N. Put J_E equal to the coefficient unit, omega_E=G_E J_E, and Q_E(K,W)=f_E^*K tensor W. For an invertible left projection define projectionCounit by inverse projection, then identity tensor the actual counit at J_E, then the right unitor; define tau by the actual adjunction Hom equivalence on this composite. Define omegaComparison by the exceptional component at J_E followed by G_F of the canonical scalar unitor. PairDomain retains precisely the two levelwise etale-origin and two finite-Tor families of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], with no cross-level compatibility. Define TensorCompatibility as the system square C_X(tau_E) followed by c_K equals the canonical scalar/pullback tensor source comparison, then identity tensor omegaComparison, then tau_F. For the shifted ordered Tate line of [det-sp-tower-gamma], define gamma as identity tensor orientation followed by tau, puritySourceComparison by the canonical tensor/pullback scalar comparison followed by the given line comparison, and unitConstraint by coefficient pullback and the left unitor. These are formulas for actual maps, not assertions that any finite family lifts.
